deviations.description: MAJOR CORRECTION to the phase's Scope Hypothesis ("exactly four call sites in three files"). A fifth, and arguably more important, call site was discovered: skill_postflight_update() in agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/skill-base.sh. Cross-checking actual invocation sites (grep -rn 'bash.*orchestrator-postflight.sh' across the whole extension) found ZERO live callers of orchestrator-postflight.sh -- its own header/skill-git-workflow/SKILL.md documentation independently confirms it is an orphaned script kept for reference only, superseded by skill-orchestrate/SKILL.md's dispatch-loop commit sites. The ACTUAL live plan-postflight path for both /orchestrate engines (standard and hard mode) is skill_postflight_update(), called from orchestrate-cycle-postflight.sh and orchestrate-stage5-postflight.sh with operation="plan"/status="planned". Without wiring this fifth site, the whole Phase 4 harvest would have been dead weight for the actual /orchestrate plan-postflight flow -- only reconcile-task-status.sh's self-heal path and skill-reviser's /revise path would ever have populated file_scope from a plan.
deviations.reason: Widened skill_postflight_update()'s existing research-only _fsa_args gate to also cover operation==plan, resolving the latest plan file from ${_task_dir}/plans/*.md (version-ordered, same convention as reconcile-task-status.sh's find_latest_artifact() and update-task-status.sh's resolve_plan_file_for_phase_check()) and harvesting via plan-file-scope-harvest.sh, with the same non-fatal degrade-on-failure posture as every other site. Added two new fixture-based test cases to test-skill-base-lifecycle.sh (Group 4a) proving the positive harvest case and the no-plans-dir absent-not-empty case; also added plan-file-scope-harvest.sh to that suite's build_fixture_repo() required-scripts list, since it was previously omitted (the branch would otherwise silently no-op against the fixture's deployed-tree copy). The kept orchestrator-postflight.sh edit is harmless (consistent with that file's own existing, equally-unreachable research branch) and left in place rather than reverted, since removing it is out of this task's scope and the dispatch explicitly named it as a site to wire.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered — discovered and wired a fifth, actually-live call site (skill_postflight_update in skill-base.sh) beyond the dispatch's four named sites; see progress file for the full finding)*
